disassembly.comparison: 439 routine headers and complete opcode sequences; binary instruction offsets independently decoded with ifvms. Operands are spot-checked, not exhaustively compared.

spotChecks.review: LUCKY selects 100 versus 300; strict greater-than is preserved.
Table length feeds RANDOM and its result indexes the same table.
Selection swaps entries and advances the stored cursor; it is stateful.
INT finds or allocates the slot before QUEUE changes its ticks.
Allocation descends through fixed six-byte slots and preserves existing slots.
Ordered slots are decremented before invocation; negative demon ticks continue; moves increment after the scan.
The outer loop repeats complete actions rather than handling individual object actions.
Match-table iteration precedes room M-END and CLOCKER; SAVE/QUIT/RESTART and other listed meta verbs skip CLOCKER. Zork III cleft code is absent.
Both match tables reset, actor/HERE/LIT are maintained, continuation paths bypass READ, and fresh input suspends at READ.
Prompt input is a nested READ; it does not return through PARSER.
QUIT happens only after the affirmative nested prompt.
Score display and confirmation precede the interpreter restart; failure text is after it.
The poison interrupt is lethal in either cage location and blocks the room.
Collapse kills the occupant; outside it schedules the ledge collapse and marks the room destroyed.
Tied balloon and on-foot deaths differ; an untied balloon survives; the ledge is destroyed afterward.
Water drives ascent and a 100-tick evaporation timer; M-END moves occupants; kicking the bucket is lethal.
Red dehydrates, orange explodes, and blue expands the player; wrong-room expansion kills rather than returning to Tea Room.
Player and robot attempts take different paths: player starts poison countdown; robot attempt removes the robot and invokes actor death.
Carrying the wand selects victory and FINISH; entering without it selects wardens death.
Actor deaths remove only the actor; player deaths subtract ten points, redistribute possessions and enter red mist. This release does not end after three deaths.

branches.PREDGEN: PERFORM uses the PREDGEN variant, including its PRSI=IT guard. The source ID 0 directive and binary release 63 remain a build-metadata discrepancy; the original build driver is unavailable.
